notices.title: Economics v2 at block 550,000 — update to 0.1.0-rc19
notices.body: At block 550,000 (≈ November 15) the block reward goes 0.01 → 0.1 HMC, every paid order burns 5%, SUP is minted per block (cap 21,000) and HMC- + 64-hex addresses become valid (your old address keeps working). Nodes older than 0.1.0-rc19 do not know these rules — update now; the updater keeps your wallet and settings.

notices.title: Orders beside Miner — use port 8081
notices.body: Miner and Orders both default to 8080. If the miner is already running, Orders now errors clearly instead of opening the miner dashboard. Run: HACKME_ORDERS_PORT=8081 bash start_hackme_orders.sh (port is remembered).

notices.title: Blake3 share-PPS · CUDA/OpenCL
notices.body: Blake3 PoH LIVE. Pool pays verified shares (SHARE_STRICT PPS at M/1024). Pool GH/s is blake3_pow_ghs (shares/wall). NVIDIA CUDA / AMD OpenCL. Hunt = Linux + bubblewrap.

notices.title: Share-PPS (verified shares)
notices.body: Each share_nonce is a PoH hit with work % (M/1024) == 0, verified by the coordinator. SHARE_STRICT pays those shares; client hashrate_gh_s is not the paycheck. Dig/Hunt remain the useful-work / bounty lanes.
